posts.body:
Hi,

ok, due to have our 1st baby, 

everything appears so expensive (in HK)...

,,..the strollers, matresses, clothes, toys... 

apart from "hand-me-downs" from friends, which are great 

(its just we only know 2 or 3 friends with young kids so not much opportunities for that...)

and apart from in the classified on this forum...

--> does anyone have any suggestion where to buy or get CHEAPER baby related items in hong kong? 

many thanks!!

try asiaxpat 

http://hongkong.asiaxpat.com/ we get loads of stuff on there, (go to classifieds, then baby and kids stuff)

or there is ecomama
